data.alertTitle: 土石流及大規模崩塌警戒
data.alertTitle_en: Debris flow and large-scale landslide warning

alertInfo.sender_name_en: Agency of Rural Development and Rural Development and Soil and Water Conservation, MOA
alertInfo.alertDesc: 農業部農村發展及水土保持署研訂各地區土石流及大規模崩塌警戒基準值，配合氣象預報及雨量資料，研判土石流災害、大規模崩塌發生之可能性並發布警戒。收到警戒訊息可於土石流及大規模崩塌防災資訊網(https://246.ardswc.gov.tw/) 首頁/防災監測/災防訊息彙整 查詢。
alertInfo.alertDesc_en: The Ministry of Agriculture studies and determines the baseline values of debris flow and large-scale landslide warnings in various regions. Cooperated with meteorological forecasts and rainfall data, they investigate the possibility of occurrence of debris flows disasters, and issue a warning report for debris flow and large-scale landslide warning zones (red or yellow warning).
alertInfo.alertRecommend:
收到土石流及大規模崩塌警戒黃色警戒時：
  • 1弱勢族群應提早疏散。
  • 2檢視居家環境安全，關好門窗。
  • 3攜帶緊急避難包、隨身衣物與重要證件，準備疏散。
  • 4持續注意收聽氣象報告與廣播電視等訊息並保持聯絡管道暢通。
收到土石流及大規模崩塌警戒紅色警戒時：
  • 1攜帶緊急避難包、隨身衣物與重要證件。
  • 2請配合鄉（鎮、市、區）公所及當地警消單位指示，疏散至村內緊急避難處所，若有災害擴大之虞，則疏散至外地收容所。
  • 3通知親友你已疏散至那個避難處所。
  • 4聯絡家人親友與疏散避難小組人員。
  • 5在自家留言。
  • 6於當地緊急避難處所或外地收容所內，靜待土石流警戒解除。
alertInfo.alertRecommend_en:
When receiving the?yellow warningof the debris flow and large-scale landslide warning:
  • 1Vulnerable groups should be evacuated early.
  • 2Check the safety of the home environment and close the doors and windows.
  • 3Carry an emergency bag, carry-on clothing and important documents, and prepare for evacuation.
  • 4Continue to listen to weather reports and broadcast TV and keep the communication channel smooth.
When receiving thered warning?of debris flow and large-scale landslide warning:
  • 1Carry an emergency bag, carry-on clothing and important documents.
  • 2Please cooperate with the township (town, city, district) public office and the local police unit to evacuate to the emergency shelter in the village. If there is supposition for the disaster to expand, then evacuate to the shelter in other places.
  • 3Inform your relatives and friends that you have evacuated to the shelter.
  • 4Contact family members and relatives and evacuation team members.
  • 5Leave a message at home.
  • 6Stay in the local emergency shelter or in the shelter in other places, and wait for thedebris flows warning to be lifted.

alertInfo.sender_name_en: Central Weather Administration, Ministry of Transportation and Communications
alertInfo.alertDesc: 大雷雨即時訊息發布方式以伴隨閃電之群聚旺盛對流為一雷雨事件，依對流生命期採不定時更新方式提供最新即時訊息。
alertInfo.alertDesc_en: The Instant Torrential Rain Alert release method is a thunderstorm event accompanied by lightning convection, and the latest instant message is provided according to the convective life cycle.
alertInfo.alertRecommend:
• 1旺盛發展的對流常伴隨打雷、閃電與劇烈降雨，並可能出現較強陣風甚或伴隨冰雹發生，若發生於溪流河川上游易於下游出現溪（河）水暴漲。
  • 2排水不良區域則易發生淹（積）水現象，強大雨勢威脅各項戶外活動並將造成能見度欠佳影響行車安全，山區易發生坍方、落石、土石流。
alertInfo.alertRecommend_en:
• 1The vigorously developed convection is often accompanied by thunder, lightning and severe rainfall, and there may be strong gusts or even hailstones. If it occurs in the upper reaches of the stream, it is easy to swell in the downstream of the stream (river).
  • 2In poorly drained areas, flooding is likely to occur. Strong rain threatens various outdoor activities and will cause poor visibility to affect driving safety. Mountain areas are prone to collapse, falling rocks, and debris flows.

alertInfo.sender_name_en: Central Weather Administration, Ministry of Transportation and Communications
alertInfo.alertDesc: 當地震預警系統預估發生規模5.0以上地震，針對預估震度可能達4級以上的縣市民眾，或預估發生規模6.5以上地震，且預估震度可能達3級以上的縣市民眾。
alertInfo.alertDesc_en: The earthquake alert is released when the earthquake magnitude scale is detected greater than 5.0, and the estimated seismic intensity scales where the city hall located in each city and county reached level 4. Or when  the earthquake magnitude scale is detected greater than 6.5, and the estimated seismic intensity scales where the city hall located in each city and county reached level 3
alertInfo.alertRecommend:
• 1在室內者應立即熄滅火源，關閉電源以防火災，然後奔逃至室外空曠地方，但應防外物倒塌（如招牌、屋瓦、廣告燈等）而被擊傷。
  • 2如一時無法逃至室外，應選一堅固、高度較矮而重心穩定之家具下（旁）躲避，並遵照趴下（drop）、掩護（cover）、穩住（hold on）的原則，以免被室內落物擊傷。
  • 3不可躲在牆邊、河、海堤或山崖附近。
  • 4沿海居民應疏遷至高地以防海嘯。
  • 5水庫下游地區居民，應防水庫崩塌所引起之山洪。
  • 6高樓之居民逃離時，切忌爭先恐後，否則易生跌倒而被踏斃，並使出口擁塞。
alertInfo.alertRecommend_en:
• People indoors should immediately extinguish the fire source, turn off the power to prevent fire, and then flee to an outdoor open space, but should avoid being injured by the collapse of objects (such as signs, roof tiles, advertising lights, etc.).
  • 2If you can't escape to the outside, you should choose to hide under (next to) sturdy, low-profile, stable furniture, and follow the principles of drop, cover, and hold on to avoid being injured by indoor falling objects.
  • 3Do not hide near walls, rivers, seawalls or cliffs.
  • 4Coastal residents should be relocated to the highlands to prevent tsunami.
  • 5Residents in the lower reaches of the reservoir should be aware of mountain flash flood caused by the collapse of the reservoir.
  • 6When the residents of the high-rises flee, they should not rush to the front, otherwise they will fall and be trampled to death and cause the congestion at the exit.

alertInfo.sender_name: 經濟部水利署、經濟部台灣電力股份有限公司、農業部農田水利署、經濟部台灣自來水公司
alertInfo.sender_name_en: Water Resources Agency, Taiwan Power Corporation, Ministry of Economic Affairs, Irrigation Agency
alertInfo.alertDesc: 水庫開始進行調節性放水、洩洪或自由溢流
alertInfo.alertDesc_en: The reservoir begins to conduct regulatory discharge, flood discharge or free overflow.
alertInfo.alertRecommend: 當發布水庫放水警戒，請下游沿岸附近民眾加強注意並遠離河道，以策安全。
alertInfo.alertRecommend_en: When releasing the reservoir flood warning, please let the downstream people and staff quickly leave the river bed to avoid danger.

alertInfo.sender_name_en: National Communications Commission
alertInfo.alertDesc: 當重大事故造成固定或行動通信網路、海底電纜等重要通信設施大範圍受損，預估將影響大量民眾通信服務達30分鐘以上時發布。
alertInfo.alertDesc_en: This alert is issued when a major incident results in widespread damage to critical telecommunications infrastructure, such as fixed-line networks, mobile networks, or submarine cable systems, and is expected to disrupt communications services for a large number of users for more than 30 minutes.
alertInfo.alertRecommend: 民眾收到災防告警訊息時，應依照告警訊息的建議盡速行動。搜尋發布單位的網站、可靠的電視、廣播等媒體，看是否有更多消息。
alertInfo.alertRecommend_en: When receiving CBS, citizens should follow the advice in the warning message, act as soon as possible, and search the website of the publishing agency、reliable TV、radio media for more information.

alertInfo.sender_name: 農業部林業及自然保育署
alertInfo.sender_name_en: Forestry and Nature Conservation Agency, Ministry of Agriculture
alertInfo.alertDesc: 因極端氣候影響，臺灣澇旱不均情況日趨嚴重，又因氣候與林下燃料極度乾燥時，人為火源使用不慎極易引發森林大火，造成生態浩劫，爰透過發布森林火災災害警戒資訊，提高民眾防災準備，減少災害發生
alertInfo.alertDesc_en: The extreme climates have taken its toll on Taiwan in terms of droughts and floods. The negligence of fire use may easily lead to forest fire and ecological catastrophe since the climates and fuels on the forest floor are extremely dry. This forest fire warning, therefore, is issued to keep people on high alert and prevent disasters from happening.
alertInfo.alertRecommend:
收到森林火災警戒時：
  • 首先不要驚慌，依通知內容或依林業署各林區管理處、地方政府指示採取預防措施。
  • 若需更進一步詳細資訊，請參考以下網站：
    (1) 農業部林業及自然保育署官網
    https://www.forest.gov.tw
    (2) 林火風險評估系統
    https://ffwi.forest.gov.tw/
alertInfo.alertRecommend_en:
When a forest fire alert is received:
  • The first thing to do is to stay calm. Follow the contents of the alert or instructions of local forest district office of Forestry Bureau or local governments for precautionary measures.
  • For further details, visit the following websites:
    (1) Forestry and Nature Conservation Agency
    https://www.forest.gov.tw
    (2) Forest fire potential database information system
    https://ffwi.forest.gov.tw/

alertInfo.sender_name: 農業部林業及自然保育署
alertInfo.sender_name_en: Forestry and Nature Conservation Agency, Ministry of Agriculture
alertInfo.alertDesc: 臺灣山區地質脆弱，地震與極端降雨易引發崩塌大量土石崩塌堵塞河道形成堰塞湖。若因堰塞湖溢流沖刷土體將對下游河道活動、 沿岸聚落與基礎設施產生威脅。爰透過發布堰塞湖警戒資訊，提高民眾防災準備，減少災害發生。
alertInfo.alertDesc_en: The mountainous areas of Taiwan have fragile geology, and earthquakes and extreme rainfall are likely to trigger landslides and mass soil collapses that block river channels, forming barrier lakes. If the barrier lakes overflow and erode the soil, they will pose a threat to downstream river activities, coastal settlements, and infrastructure. Therefore, issuing warning information about barrier lakes is crucial to enhance public disaster preparedness and reduce the occurrence of disasters.
alertInfo.alertRecommend:
收到堰塞湖警報時：
  • 首先不要驚慌，依通知內容或依林業及自然保育署各地區分署、地方政府指示採取預防措施。
  • 若需更進一步詳細資訊，請參考以下網站：
    (1) 農業部林業及自然保育署官網
    https://www.forest.gov.tw
    (2) 國有林防災應變及堰塞湖監測系統
    https://gov.tw/Vef
alertInfo.alertRecommend_en:
When a Barrier Lake alert is received:
  • First, remain calm and follow the instructions in the notice or take preventive measures as directed by the regional offices of the Forestry and Nature Conservation Agency or local government authorities.
  • For further details, visit the following websites:
    (1) Forestry and Nature Conservation Agency
    https://www.forest.gov.tw
    (2) National Forest Disaster Response and Barrier Lake Monitoring System
    https://gov.tw/Vef

alertInfo.sender_name_en: Water Resources Agency
alertInfo.alertDesc: 於應變開設至一定層級(經濟部二級、水災中央、風災中央)時，於中央氣象署發布大豪雨特報以上區域，且達一級淹水警戒1小時及3小時警戒雨量值，經水利署應變小組確認後發布淹水警戒細胞廣播訊息，如有特殊狀況，將依實際需求增發。
alertInfo.alertDesc_en: When the response level reaches a certain threshold (Central Emergency Operation Center, Second Level Prevent and Rescue Open of the Ministry of Economic Affairs Flood Emergency Response Center), and the Central Weather Administration issues an Heavy Torrential Rain Advisory or higher for the affected areas, a flood warning cell broadcast message will be issued once the First Level flood warning thresholds for 1-hour and 3-hour cumulative rainfall are met and confirmed by the Water Resources Agency's response team. Additional broadcasts may be issued as needed in response to special circumstances.
alertInfo.alertRecommend: 如持續降雨，請民眾加強注意並提高警覺，減少外出，即時做好擋水阻水避免水溢淹至屋內，必要時將電器、貴重物品移至高處，相關資訊可查詢https://fhy.wra.gov.tw/fhyv2/  或洽所在地縣市政府 。
alertInfo.alertRecommend_en: If the rainfall continues, please remain vigilant and take extra precautions. Limit outdoor activities and take immediate measures to block or divert water to prevent flooding inside your home. If necessary, move electrical appliances and valuable items to higher ground.For more information, please visit  https://fhy.wra.gov.tw/fhyv2/ or contact your local city or county government.

alertInfo.sender_name_en: Central Weather Administration
alertInfo.alertDesc: 針對即將遭受巨浪影響之沿海地區，提供即時告警，研判或預測某沿海地區將出現6公尺以上浪高威脅時發布。
alertInfo.alertDesc_en: Provide real-time alerts for coastal areas that are about to be affected by large waves, and issue warnings when it is assessed or predicted that a coastal area will experience a significant wave height threat of 6 meters or more..
alertInfo.alertRecommend: 請遠離沿岸地區。
alertInfo.alertRecommend_en: Please stay away from the coastal areas.

alertInfo.sender_name: 經濟部台灣中油股份有限公司、經濟部台灣電力股份有限公司
alertInfo.sender_name_en: CPC Corporation, Taiwan
alertInfo.alertDesc:
中油煉油廠、天然氣廠所屬管線、設施發生火災或爆炸，針對廠區週遭區域居民，發布緊急警報。
台電公司所轄各電廠發生火災時依據災害發生後狀況及處置措施於適當時機發布警報。
alertInfo.alertDesc_en: A fire or explosion occurred in the pipelines and facilities of the CNPC refinery and the natural gas plant, and an emergency warning was issued for residents in the surrounding areas of the plant.
alertInfo.alertRecommend:
• 1提高注意，並請勿靠近廠區。
  • 2為防止煙塵影響民眾呼吸道健康，請附近民眾，暫停戶外活動。
  • 3遵守警消人員指示，是否要疏散或就地居家掩蔽。如果是疏散，請關緊門窗、熄滅火源；如採取就地區加掩蔽，請進入室內，將門窗關閉，空調冷氣關閉或切成室內循環。
  • 4請勿圍觀，避免妨礙救災。
  • 5事前先了解避難逃生路線圖。
  • 6儘速離開災區現場，以手帕、濕布掩住口鼻，盡量往上風處離開。
alertInfo.alertRecommend_en:
• 1Raise your attention and do not approach the factory.
  • 2In order to prevent smoke and dust from affecting people's respiratory health, please stop the outdoor activities for nearby people.
  • 3Follow the instructions of the police officer or firefighters to evacuate or hide in the home. If it is evacuation, please close the doors and windows and put out the fire source; if it is hiding at the site, please enter the building and close the doors and windows, and turn off the air conditioner or switch to inddor circulation.
  • 4Don't crowd around, and avoid obstructing disaster relief.
  • 5Learn about the escape route map beforehand.
  • 6Leave the disaster area as soon as possible, cover your mouth and nose with a handkerchief and a damp cloth, and try to go to the windward place.

alertInfo.messageType: 國家級警報 / 警訊通知
alertInfo.sender_name_en: Ministry of National Defense
alertInfo.alertDesc: 當預判飛彈、敵機、火箭或其他可能對我國領土有影響並具威脅，對國人生命財產有危害時， 國防部立即發布防空警報告警訊息， 通知民眾採取防護措施，以降低損害，保障國人生命財產安全。
alertInfo.alertDesc_en: When it is assessed that missiles, enemy aircraft, rockets, or other threats may impact the territory of our nation and pose a danger to the lives and property of the people, the Ministry of National Defense will immediately issue an air defense alert to notify the public to take protective measures, thereby reducing damage and safeguarding the safety of lives and property.
alertInfo.alertRecommend: 民眾應接受憲警及民防人員指（誘）導確實進入防空避難處所，居家者應緊閉門窗及實施燈火管制。
alertInfo.alertRecommend_en: Upon receiving the alert, the public should use the air defense evacuation and shelter guideline link provided in the message to locate the nearest shelter, or immediately evacuate as directed by police or fire personnel.

alertInfo.sender_name_en: Central Weather Administration, Ministry of Transportation and Communications
alertInfo.alertDesc: 當中央氣象署發布臺灣地區海嘯警報或解除臺灣地區海嘯警報，針對臺澎金馬沿岸的鄉鎮市區民眾。
alertInfo.alertDesc_en: When the Central Weather Administration issues or lifts a tsunami warning in Taiwan, it is aimed for the coastal residents in Taiwan, Penghu, Kinmen and Matsu.
alertInfo.alertRecommend:
• 1當海嘯發生時，攜帶所需物品（如：水、食物等）往高處逃離，最好是堅固的建築物或屋頂，若時間允許可先打開所有門窗，以減少海嘯對建築物的衝擊。
  • 2避難過程中若是短距離，則盡量不要使用車輛，以免捲入海嘯時在車內無法脫困。
  • 3假如無法立即往高處移動，則應尋找任何固定物（如：大樹、鋼筋等）並緊緊抓牢。
  • 4有救生衣應盡速穿上，並尋找漂浮物抓住或爬上大型漂浮物。
  • 5若已經處在水中則應避免受到大型漂浮物的碰撞。
alertInfo.alertRecommend_en:
• 1When the tsunami occurs, carry the required items (such as water, food, etc.) to the heights, preferably a strong building or rooftop. If time permits, you can open all doors and windows to reduce the impact of the tsunami on the building.
  • 2If it is a short distance during the evacuation process, avoid using the vehicle so as not to be trapped in the car when it is drawn into the tsunami.
  • 3If you can't move to a high place immediately, you should look for any fixtures (such as big trees, steel bars, etc.) and hold on to them.
  • 4Life jackets should be worn as soon as possible, and look for floating objects to grab or climb onto large floating objects.
  • 5If you are already in the water, avoid collision with large floating objects.

alertInfo.sender_name_en: Central Weather Administration, Ministry of Transportation and Communications
alertInfo.alertDesc: 於颱風侵臺期間，針對即將遭受颱風劇烈強風影響之陸上地區，提供即時告警，研判或預測某地區將受颱風風力平均風達12級（含）以上或陣風達14級（含）以上威脅時發布。
alertInfo.alertDesc_en: During the typhoon's invasion in Taiwan, we provide immediate warnings for land areas that will be affected by the strong winds of the typhoons. We issue the warning when it is judged or predicted that an area will be affected by typhoon winds above level 12 (inclusive) or gusts up to level 14 (inclusive).
alertInfo.alertRecommend:
• 1室外懸掛物、招牌、圍籬及鷹架等應加強固牢，陽臺之盆景等應妥善放置。
  • 2海面航行及作業船隻應注意風浪。
alertInfo.alertRecommend_en:
• 1Outdoor hangings, signs, fences and scaffolding should be strengthened, and the bonsai of the balcony should be properly placed.
  • 2Navigation on the sea and vessels in operation should pay attention to wind and waves.

alertInfo.sender_name_en: Central Weather Administration, Ministry of Transportation and Communications
alertInfo.alertDesc: 火山活動等級達2級，可能致災，須採取預防等應變事宜。
alertInfo.alertDesc_en: The disaster will be happened when the volcanic activity raise to level 2. First of all,the emergency management must be prepared.
alertInfo.alertRecommend: 依警報內容或相關指示進行避難或採取適當應變措施。
alertInfo.alertRecommend_en: Evacuate according to the content of the alert message.

alertInfo.sender_name_en: Hiway Bureau, Ministry of Transportation and Communications
alertInfo.alertDesc: 因道路崩塌災害等因素，造成道路封閉，警告道路封閉範圍內的用路人。
alertInfo.alertDesc_en: Road closure due to road collapse and other factors, warning should be given to the road users within the closed road.
alertInfo.alertRecommend:
• 1請用路人於出發前，先行由交通部公路局網頁之防災特報，瞭解本局轄區道路警示訊息，並預先規劃行程避免行經各警示路段；另亦可利用公路防救災資訊系統。點我前往瞭解道路通阻情形
  • 2行駛於本局轄管道路之用路人，請留意CMS資訊可變標誌及警廣所傳遞之道路訊息
alertInfo.alertRecommend_en:
• 1Road users should refer to the disaster prevention special report on the website of the Directorate of Highways before the departure to understand the road warning messages in this area, and plan the itinerary ahead to avoid passing the warning roads. You can also use the road disaster prevention information systemclick me?to understand the road traffic conditions.
  • 2For road users on the roads under governance of this directorate, please pay attention to the CMS Information Variable Sign and the road information transmitted by Police Broadcasting.

alertInfo.sender_name_en: Ministry of Environment
alertInfo.alertDesc: 監測空氣污染物（懸浮微粒、細懸浮微粒）濃度，並換算為空氣品質指標，此指標達空氣品質嚴重惡化三級以上（AQI＞200），即發布警訊。
alertInfo.alertDesc_en: A monitoring on the concentration of air contaminants (particulate matter, fine particulate matter) and convert it into air quality index. A warning will be issued once the index reaches more than air quality index high risk tier 3 (AQI>200).
alertInfo.alertRecommend:
• 1一般民眾如果有不適，如眼痛，咳嗽或喉嚨痛等，應減少體力消耗，特別是減少戶外活動。
  • 2學生應避免長時間劇烈運動，進行其他戶外活動時應增加休息時間。
  • 3有心臟、呼吸道及心血管疾病患者、孩童及老年人，建議留在室內並減少體力消耗活動，必要外出應配戴口罩。
  • 4具有氣喘的人可能需增加使用吸入劑的頻率。
alertInfo.alertRecommend_en:
• 1If any discomfort appears on the general public, such as sore eyes, cough or sore throat, physical consumption should be reduced, especially the reduction of outdoor activities.
  • 2Students should avoid long-time vigorous exercise, and the break time should be increased when conducting other outdoor activities.
  • 3It is suggested that patients with heart, respiratory tract, and cardiovascular diseases, children, and the elderly should stay indoors and reduce activities involving with physical consumption. Wear surgical masks if they need to go out.
  • 4People with asthma might need to increase the frequency of using the inhaler.

alertInfo.sender_name: 環境部化學物質管理署
alertInfo.sender_name_en: Chemicals Administration, Ministry of Environment
alertInfo.alertDesc: 當你所在的地區，有列管毒性化學物質第1類至第3類洩漏情形，經評估其狀態及數量可能會影響民眾身體健康安全，地方政府會依規定發布細胞廣播。
alertInfo.alertDesc_en: If there is leak of listed Class I, Class II, or Class III toxic and chemical substances in your location, the local government may have a cell broadcast in accordance with regulations depending on whether the condition and amount can harm the health and safety of the people.
alertInfo.alertRecommend: 儘速尋找附近住家或室內地點就地避難、如您在家請儘速緊閉門窗，並上網查詢您所在縣市的防災網、環保局網站或打開電視找尋相關訊息，並配合縣市政府或村里長的指示避免外出或疏散避難。
alertInfo.alertRecommend_en: Please evacuate to the nearest housing or indoor space. If you’re at home, please close the door and windows, and receive relevant information on the website of the local disaster prevention info or department of environment protection, or on the TV. You should also follow instruction from city/county government or village chief to evacuate or to avoid going outside.

alertInfo.sender_name_en: Nuclear Safety Commission
alertInfo.alertDesc: 核安會、地方政府及相關災害防救機關於事故發生且有放射性物質外釋或外釋之虞時，應適時透過預警系統、細胞廣播服務CBS）及各類傳播媒體，將事故資訊傳達民眾。
alertInfo.alertDesc_en: In the event of accidents and the release or supposition of release of radioactive materials, the Nuclear Safety Commission, local government and related disaster prevention and rescue agencies should timely communicate the accident information through the early warning system, Cell Broadcast Service (CBS) and various media to the people.
alertInfo.alertRecommend:
採取掩蔽行動：

  • 1如果您正在室內，請不要外出。如果您人正在室外，請回到家裡或進入附近的建築物內。
  • 2關緊門、窗，減少室外空氣流到室內。
  • 3打開電視或收音機瞭解最新的狀況。
  • 4電話掛好，以便隨時接聽緊急通知。
  • 5暴露在外的食物和飲水不要食用。
  • 6室內的飲水和食物，未受到污染，可以安全食用。
  • 7如果您正在車上，請立刻關上車窗、 打開收音機收聽廣播，瞭解最新的情況，離開事故地區或進入室內。
  • 8學校的學生，聽到事故的警報或廣播，要迅速進入教室內，將教室的門窗關閉，聽從老師的指示。

更多資訊
alertInfo.alertRecommend_en:
Take the hiding action:

  • 1If you are indoors, please don't go out. If you are outdoors, return home or enter a nearby building.
  • 2Close the doors and windows to reduce the outdoor air flow to the room.
  • 3Turn on the TV or radio to get the latest information.
  • 4Hang up the phone properly so that you can receive emergency notifications at any time.
  • 5Do not eat food and water that are exposed.
  • 6Indoor drinking water and food are not contaminated and can be eaten safely.
  • 7If you are in the car, please close the window immediately, turn on the radio to listen to the radio, learn about the latest situation, leave the accident area or enter a building.
  • 8When the students in the school hear an alarm or broadcast of an accident, they should quickly enter the classroom, close the doors and windows of the classroom, and follow the instructions of the teacher.

More information

alertInfo.sender_name: 經濟部台灣中油股份有限公司
alertInfo.sender_name_en: CPC Corporation, Taiwan
alertInfo.alertDesc: 桃園(大林)煉油廠、台中(永安)天然氣廠含所轄管線設施發生爆炸，經廠長或授權人員判斷認為情節重大後，針對廠區週遭區域居民，發布緊急警報。
alertInfo.alertDesc_en: Explosions happened in the pipeline facilities under the jurisdiction of the Taoyuan (Dalin) Refinery and the Taichung (Yong-An) Natural Gas Plant. After the plant director or authorized personnel determined that the circumstances were serious, an emergency alert was issued for the residents around the plant.
alertInfo.alertRecommend:
• 1提高注意，並請勿靠近廠區。
  • 2為防止煙塵影響民眾呼吸道健康，請附近民眾，暫停戶外活動。
  • 3遵守警消人員指示，是否要疏散或就地居家掩蔽。如果是疏散，請關緊門窗、熄滅火源；如採取就地區加掩蔽，請進入室內，將門窗關閉，空調冷氣關閉或切成室內循環。
  • 4請勿圍觀，避免妨礙救災。
  • 5事前先了解避難逃生路線圖。
  • 6儘速離開災區現場，以手帕、濕布掩住口鼻，盡量往上風處離開。
alertInfo.alertRecommend_en:
• 1Raise your attention and do not approach the factory.
  • 2In order to prevent smoke and dust from affecting people's respiratory health, please stop the outdoor activities for nearby people.
  • 3Follow the instructions of the police officer or firefighters to evacuate or hide in the home. If it is evacuation, please close the doors and windows and put out the fire source; if it is hiding at the site, please enter the building and close the doors and windows, and turn off the air conditioner or switch to inddor circulation.
  • 4Don't crowd around, and avoid obstructing disaster relief.
  • 5Learn about the escape route map beforehand.
  • 6Leave the disaster area as soon as possible, cover your mouth and nose with a handkerchief and a damp cloth, and try to go to the windward place.

alertInfo.sender_name: 衛生福利部疾病管制署
alertInfo.sender_name_en: Taiwan Centers for Disease Control
alertInfo.alertDesc: 疾病管制署蒐集重要傳染病疫情及可能引發疫情的相關資訊，研判有流行疫情發生之虞時，將發布訊息予可能受影響區域民眾。
alertInfo.alertDesc_en: The Centers for Disease Control collects information on major infectious disease epidemics and possible outbreaks. It will report to people in the affected areas when there is expected to be a pandemic.
alertInfo.alertRecommend:
• 1配合政府機關之政策，協助疫情控制，如清除孳生源、接觸者配合施打疫苗。
  • 2如有不適，儘速就醫並告知醫師旅遊史。疾管署免付費防疫專線：1922
alertInfo.alertRecommend_en:
• 1Cooperate with the policies of government agencies to assist in the control of the epidemic, such as clearing the breeding sources and the in-contacts receiving the vaccination.
  • 2If you feel unwell, seek medical attention as soon as possible and inform your doctor about your travel history. CDC free of charge and anti-epidemic line: 1922

alertInfo.sender_name_en: 22 Special Municipality, Country (City) Government
alertInfo.alertDesc: 各縣市於災害發生或有發生之虞時，將發布疏散避難警報。
alertInfo.alertDesc_en: All counties and cities will issue evacuation warnings when disasters occur or are expected to occur.
alertInfo.alertRecommend:
• 依告警訊息內容進行疏散或避難。
  • 搜尋發布縣市政府的網站。
alertInfo.alertRecommend_en:
• Evacuate according to the content of the alert message.
  • Search the website of the county and city government that issues the message.

alertInfo.sender_name_en: Agriculture and Food Agency, Ministry of Agriculture
alertInfo.alertDesc: 經評估平地氣溫將降至攝氏6度以下連續24小時，針對該等地區的直轄市、縣（市）民眾進行警訊發佈。
alertInfo.alertDesc_en: When it is evaluated that the temperatures at the plains will be dropped to lower than 6 ˚C for consecutive 24 hours, a warning will be issued to the public at the municipality and county (city) in that area.
alertInfo.alertRecommend:
• 1蔬菜與瓜果類部分

    對較不耐寒蔬菜與瓜果類作物，應設置防風牆、防風罩、塑膠布或選用稻草或不織布直接覆蓋，採畦溝灌溉方式，以達保溫防寒效果；未採收瓜果，則以套袋處理，避免寒害。

  • 2果樹部分

    加強包裹樹幹、果實套袋及表土覆蓋等防寒設施，冷氣團過境時，實施果園噴水；增施鉀肥，以增加作物耐寒力。尤其香蕉、草莓、木瓜更須留意。對已受害之果樹，應行修剪寒害枝條與葉片及疏花、疏果等措施。

  • 3花卉部分

    除搭設塑膠棚溫室等設施加強保護外，種苗苗圃應加強畦溝灌溉或以塑膠布直接覆蓋，以達保溫防寒效果，田間酌量增施鉀肥，以增加耐寒力。

  • 4茶樹部分

    當寒流來襲前及時在樹冠上覆蓋PE塑膠布、遮陰網等覆蓋物或撒上薄層稻草，地面敷蓋有機資材，保護茶樹。

  • 5養殖業者部分

    (A)於魚塭北側搭蓋防風棚、加深水深，加強越冬溝之保溫、防寒及加溫等設備。
    (B)低溫期間儘量避免擾動水體或驚動魚塭內魚群，應暫停投餌及不要無謂地開關水車。
    (C)在氣溫回升、暖和之日，視情況再酌投飼料。
    (D)低溫侵襲或留滯時，應注意水溫降低之速度，水溫若低於15℃時，應採緊急措施，如加溫以提高水溫，俾減輕死亡。
    (E)必要時規劃儘早採捕，以減少寒害損失。
    (F)低溫與寒流過後，浮於水面之魚體應馬上撿除，防止水質惡化。

  • 4養畜禽業

    加強仔畜禽的保溫及管理，設置擋風設施，隨時注意畜禽舍溫溼度，保持通風的環境並防範冷風的侵襲，以避免損失。

人員部分：

人員應妥善採取禦寒措施，尤其有高血壓、心血管、腦血管疾病或慢性病病患務必注意並預防低溫促發的異常狀況。


  • 若需更進一步詳細資訊，請參考以下網站：
    (1) 農業部官網
    https://www.moa.gov.tw/
    (2) 農業部農糧署官網
    https://www.afa.gov.tw/cht/index.php
    (3) 農業部臉書社群
    https://www.facebook.com/TaiwanMOA
alertInfo.alertRecommend_en:
• Vegetables, fruits, and melons:

    Vegetables, fruits and melons that are with low cold resistance should be protected with windbreak, windscreen or plastic sheet or be covered directly by straw or non-woven fabric. Ridge furrow irrigation should be used in order to achieve the effect of insulation and cold protection. Fruits and melons that are not harvested should be applied with bagging treatment to avoid chilling injury.

  • Fruit trees:

    Cold-resistant facilities, such as bagging on tree trunks and fruits or surface soil covering, should be strengthened. During the transition of cold air mass, water spray should be implemented and additional potassic fertilizer will be required in order to increase cold resistance on the crops. Pay extra attention on banana, strawberry, and papaya. Measures of cutting out branches and leaves that are damaged by chilling injury or flower thinning and fruit thinning should be carried out on the damaged free trees.

  • Flowers:

    Other than installing plastic-covered greenhouse for reinforced protection, nursery for seeding should be strengthened with ridge furrow irrigation or be covered directly with plastic sheet in order to achieve the effect of insulation and cold protection. Potassic fertilizer should be used in the field according to the actual situation in order to increase cold resistance.

  • Tea trees:

    Cover tea crown with PE plastic sheet and shading net before the arrival of the cold current timely or spread thin layer of straw on top of it as well as cover the ground with organic materials to protect tea tree.

  • Aquaculture:

    Put up wind-resistant canopy in the north of fish farm, deepen the depth of water, and strengthen the insulation, cold resistance, and heating facilities in the hibernation ditch.

    During the low temperature, try not to disturb the water or the fish in the farm; temporarily stop feeding and do not turn on and off the water wheel if it is not necessary.

    After the temperature goes up again and the weather is warm, determine for whether to start feeding according to the real situation.

    Pay attention on the speed of water temperature drop when the low temperature arrives or holds up. If the water temperature is lower than 15℃, emergency responding measures, such as heating up, should be taken to increase the water temperature in order to reduce death damage.

    If it is necessary, make a plan for early catching-up to reduce the loss caused by chilling injury.

    After the low temperature and cold current, all the fish floating on the water must be removed immediately to avoid degradation of water quality.

  • Livestock farming:

    Reinforce heat retaining and management of new-born livestock, install windbreak facility, pay attention on the temperature and humidity of the livestock housing, maintain ventilation, and prevent the attack of the cold wind in order to avoid losses.

For personnel:

Personnel should take proper cold protection measures; patients with high blood pressure, cardiovascular, cerebrovascular or chronic illness must pay extra attention and prevent the abnormal conditions that trigger by the low temperature.

alertInfo.sender_name: 經濟部台灣電力股份有限公司
alertInfo.sender_name_en: Taiwan Power Corporation, Ministry of Economic Affairs
alertInfo.alertDesc: 電力設施因事故造成大規模停電，需執行緊急分區輪流停電。
alertInfo.alertDesc_en: Power facilities caused large-scale power outages due to accidents, and emergent district rotation power outage should be carried out.
alertInfo.alertRecommend:
• 1相關停電訊息請至台電公司官網查詢
  • 2籲請民眾節約用電，空調設定溫度每調高1℃，就可節省約6%電力，並關掉不使用的電器以利電力系統穩定運轉。高鐵及臺鐵各班次列車正常行駛、下車旅客及接送親友應即依引導實施疏散避難。
  • 3輪流停電期間，請密切注意台電公司官網訊息，請盡量避免使用電梯等設備以防停電時受困。
alertInfo.alertRecommend_en:
• 1For related power outages, please go to Taipower's official website.
  • 2People are urged to save electricity. When the air conditioning set temperature is increased by 1 °C, about 6% of the electricity can be saved, and turn off the unused electrical appliancesto facilitate the stable operation of the power system. Taiwan High Speed Rail and Taiwan Railways operate normally, the passengers who disembark and the pick-up and drop-off people should be guided to evacuate.
  • 3During the power outage, please pay close attention to the official website of Taipower Company. Please try to avoid using elevators and other equipment to prevent being trapped during power outages.
